_recorded: 2026-10-04, local stand, maintmode @ 09abc73 (feat/accept-invite-password). POST /api/v1/users/invitations/accept/password sent with curl straight to the backend; status, Cache-Control and body copied off the wire.
_masked: access_token and refresh_token in `success` are replaced with placeholders — they are live bearer tokens. Their presence and types, `expires_in` and its value, and every error envelope are the backend's own.
_not_recorded: 403 seats_limit_exceeded and 409 conflict are not here: the dev stand has no licence block (no seat limit), and producing an existing account for an invited address needs a real Google sign-in. Their handling is covered by unit tests against the announced contract only.
